slice: Chassis, controls, wheels, brakes, drivetrain, protection
notes: Prices are as listed on the retailer page on the retrieval date (2026-10-14) unless another date is given. Retailer item numbers (Cycle Gear/RevZilla 'P...'/UPC) are NOT manufacturer part numbers and are labelled as such. Rider feedback is paraphrased.

platforms.description: KTM SX/SX-F 2023+ generation: revised hydroformed frame (thicker walls, shock mount off main tube; 2-strokes get parallel frame mounts for flex), new hollow die-cast swingarm, 22 mm rear axle, shorter WP XACT shock (300 mm travel) with more linkage ground clearance, CNC billet triple clamps with tuned stem stiffness (22 mm offset), topology-optimised bar mounts (rubber or solid), footpegs moved inward and ~26% larger. Debuted early on the 2022 250/450 SX-F Factory Edition (aftermarket fitment lists group the 2022 FE with 2023+).

2027 KTM SX-F range described as largely unchanged (graphics plus engine/sound-regulation updates); 22 mm clamp offset, Excel rims 1.60x21 / 2.15x19, Brembo 260/220 mm discs, Neken tapered bar with ODI grips. Several aftermarket fitment lists (P3, Raptor) already include 2027 models, consistent with carry-over chassis.
platforms.models_years: KTM 250/350/450 SX-F 2027 (2-stroke SX 2027 appears in Raptor footpeg list)

platforms.description: KTM XC/XC-F cross-country on the 2023+ chassis. KTM's 2023 media page covers only SX/SX-F; XC inclusion is inferred from aftermarket and KTM PowerParts fitment lists (Factory triple clamp, Raptor pegs, TM Designworks) that group XC/XC-F 2023+ with SX. 2024 update: WP XACT closed-cartridge spring fork replaces air fork, 18x2.15 rear wheel, Brembo 260/220 discs.

Husqvarna TC/FC/TX/FX on the 2023+ shared KTM-family chassis (2022 FC 250/450 Rockstar Edition grouped with it in aftermarket lists). 2026 Factory Editions add Factory Racing offset-adjustable CNC clamps, Factory Racing CNC hubs on Excel rims, RK GB520MXU chain, carbon skid plate and disc guard, ProTaper tapered bar; Brembo 260/220 discs.

GasGas MC/EX 2024+: new-generation frame (anti-squat, wall thickness), all-aluminium subframe, new 22 mm rear axle, one-piece cast swingarm, FORGED aluminium clamps (KTM/Husky use billet) with more flexible stem and adjustable bar mounts, Braktec calipers with 260/220 discs, larger footpegs mounted further inward. Same chassis specs for MC 125/250 (2T) and 250F/350F/450F (4T). MC 250F/450F Factory Edition 2023 already used the new chassis per aftermarket lists.

Previous KTM-family MX/XC generation (KTM SX/SX-F/XC/XC-F 2016/2017-2022, Husqvarna TC/FC 2016-2022, GasGas MC 2021-2023). GasGas MC 2021-2023 used cast/forged clamps and Brembo controls. Included only where products in this pass also cover it.
platforms.models_years: KTM SX/SX-F/XC/XC-F 2016-2022; Husqvarna TC/FC/TX/FX 2016-2022; GasGas MC/EX 2021-2023

platforms.description: KTM 85 SX new generation 2025: new chromoly frame based on full-size SX concept, head angle 63.5 deg (0.5 deg flatter), steering lock 35 deg, head 6 mm rearward, engine rotated 3 deg, new one-piece polyamide/aluminium subframe, new die-cast swingarm (-300 g), 20 mm rear axle, revised clamps and new footpegs. Whether TC 85 / MC 85 share it was not stated in the source.

products.product: ROCS Tech triple clamp kit (black), KTM/Husqvarna 2023-24, GasGas 2024, 22 mm offset
products.variants: Fixed OEM offset (22 mm per listing title); black. ROCS Pro is the adjustable-offset version.

fits.notes: Listing title says KTM/Husqvarna 23-24; description names only KTM SX/SX-F 2023; retailer has no fitment table set
From listing title only; GasGas stock clamps are forged, so this is a bigger change than on KTM

products.what_it_changes: Manufacturer claims (via retailer): split clamps with elastomer-isolated design keep clamp bore round under load for better fork sensitivity, more resistance to fork twisting, improved fork bending line, independent pinch-bolt preload, lower weight.
products.supporting_parts: No stem nut included (reuse OEM). Bar mounts not included (optional Xtrig bar mounts).
products.caveats: 2025-2026 fitment not confirmed by any source found; years beyond 2024 should be checked with Xtrig. Manufacturer (xtrig.de) page not reached.

products.product: ROCS Pro triple clamp kit, KTM SX/SX-F 2023+ / EXC 2024+
products.variants: Offset adjustable 20-22 mm per Maciag listing. Keefer (2023) refers to running Xtrig ROCS clamps at 24 mm - conflicts with the 20-22 mm range listed; may be a different insert/version.

fits.notes: Listed as 'SX/SX-F 23-' (open-ended); later years implied but not enumerated

products.what_it_changes: Same ROCS claims as ROCS Tech (round clamp bore, fork-twist resistance, lighter) plus adjustable offset; offset changes trail and therefore steering quickness vs straight-line stability.
products.supporting_parts: Includes steering stem and steering head bearings. Requires Xtrig M12 handlebar mounts (sold separately).

rider_feedback.author: Kris Keefer
rider_feedback.summary: Names Xtrig 24 mm ROCS clamps as giving results similar to Ride Engineering 23.5 mm clamps (more planted off-throttle, easier corner entry).

products.caveats: No manufacturer part number found. Husqvarna/GasGas fitment not stated on this listing.

products.product: Factory Racing Triple Clamp (orange), offset-adjustable
products.variants: Offset 20 mm or 22 mm. Another KTM Direct listing exists as A46001999021C1A (variant not checked).
products.what_it_changes: KTM claims: shorter offset favours stability on fast straights, longer offset favours quicker cornering; tuned stem stiffness, fork-clamp geometry that avoids ovalising the WP outer tube, more stable front-wheel control.
products.supporting_parts: Includes steering stem with bearing pressed on.

rider_feedback.author: Smith246
rider_feedback.summary: KTM PowerParts 22 mm split clamps take a little sting out of the hands; noticeable but not huge; would prioritise suspension work over clamps.

products.caveats: Dealer page lists only KTM models; Husqvarna/GasGas use their own-colour Factory clamps (2026 Husqvarna FE ships with Factory Racing offset-adjustable clamps). Dealer page showed both 'in stock' and 'coming soon'.

products.product: Gen3 Pro triple clamp set (KTM-family), plus Gen3 Standard 23.5 mm
products.variants: Pro: adjustable offset, used at 22-24 mm by forum riders; Standard: fixed 23.5 mm (added per Luxon rep, May 2024). Rocky Mountain ATV/MC lists rubber-isolated and solid bar-mount versions.

fits.notes: From rider reports only; manufacturer fitment page not reached

products.what_it_changes: Luxon rep: most Gen3 Pro buyers for KTM chose 23-24 mm; adjustable offset is the key feature. Longer offset reduces trail.
products.supporting_parts: Bar mount type chosen at purchase (rubber or solid) per retailer listing titles.

rider_feedback.author: NeedMoto
rider_feedback.summary: 24 mm Luxon clamps removed corner-entry nervousness, tracked better in ruts and turned better.

rider_feedback.author: rpm.15
rider_feedback.summary: Luxon Pro at 24 mm 'calmed the beast down'.

rider_feedback.author: Chris_Buehler
rider_feedback.summary: Counterpoint: his issue is nervousness not turning, unsure more offset is the fix.

products.caveats: Retailer page blocked by bot protection; no SKU, price or year range verified. Husqvarna/GasGas fitment unverified.

products.product: Billet split triple clamp set (KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas)
part_numbers: KT-BBM00-CA (rubber-mounted oversize bar mount kit, needed on GasGas)
products.variants: 22 mm (pre-2023 tested set) and 23.5 mm (2023+ KTM per Keefer and forum). Black, blue, orange, red, chrome.

fits.notes: 23.5 mm version per Keefer and Vital riders; no RE fitment page checked

products.what_it_changes: Split clamps add controlled flex/comfort; 23.5 mm offset (vs 22 stock) reduces trail for easier turn-in while testers report better off-throttle stability on the 2023+ KTM.
products.supporting_parts: Set includes clamps, stem, lower bearing and hour-meter relocation bracket (MXA 2021). GasGas needs KTM/Husky rubber bar mount kit KT-BBM00-CA.

rider_feedback.author: MXA test crew
rider_feedback.summary: Stock GasGas forged clamps flexed (vague turn-in, front wag); stock KTM billet more accurate but harsher; RE split clamps a compromise. Pros preferred 14/11 lb-ft top/bottom torque vs RE's 13/10.

rider_feedback.author: Kris Keefer
rider_feedback.summary: 23.5 mm RE clamps: more planted leaning off throttle, better straight-line stability, easier corner entry, less front tuck on flat turns, less hand vibration.

rider_feedback.author: TahoeVetMX / zwolf734 / GPrider
rider_feedback.summary: 23.5 mm RE clamps: more stable, turns better, plusher in the hands.

products.caveats: No clamp part number found for the 2023+ 23.5 mm set; price is 2021 for the older set.

products.product: Scotts steering stabilizer with metal SUB (under-bar) mount kit, KTM/Husky 23-25, GasGas 24-25
part_numbers: SCO-DS-SUB-6125-01 (Shock Treatment SKU; appears to follow Scotts DS-xxxx-01 numbering)
products.variants: Solid or rubber (Performance Adjustable) SUB mount; mount-kit-only option.

fits.model: TC / FC (and TX/FX per Upshift list)

products.what_it_changes: Adds adjustable steering damping (head-shake control); SUB mount converts rubber-mounted bars to solid and raises bars ~24 mm (11-25 mm by model) with two fore-aft positions; Upshift listing notes 3 mm offset perches.
products.supporting_parts: Oversize (1-1/8) bars; cable guide (sold separately; Clean Speed guide recommended); factory steering lock must be removed; damper and link arm not included in mount-only kit.
products.caveats: 2026-2027 fitment not listed. Bar height change may need a lower bend.

products.product: Pro Launch start device
part_numbers: Cycle Gear item P400381 (KTM 2017-2022 listing; retailer number)
products.variants: Red/black; separate listings per brand/year range.
products.what_it_changes: Fork-compression holeshot device (spring-less trigger, ~50 g) to lower the front for starts.
products.supporting_parts: Drill template and countersink tool included; designed for OEM fork guards only (requires drilling).
products.caveats: No listing confirming KTM 2023+ or GasGas 2024+ found; 2023+ KTM OEM bikes have a factory holeshot device - not researched.

products.product: Engine mount kit for 2023+ KTM (lower mounts, titanium bolt, upper hangers, separate exhaust mount)

fits.notes: Article: fits 2022.5+ SX-F and 2023+ SX-F and XC-F 450; other sizes not addressed

products.what_it_changes: Tuned mount flex: tester reported less bar harshness on decel and better front edge grip in hard flat turns.
products.supporting_parts: Exhaust mount uses a rear nut (less convenient than stock).

rider_feedback.author: Todd Davis
rider_feedback.summary: Less harshness on decel, better hard-pack turn grip; good on soft round bumps, less so on square-edge/high speed; pricey for the change.

products.caveats: No part number or manufacturer page checked.

products.product: Aftermarket engine mounts (medium and soft)
products.variants: Medium, soft
products.what_it_changes: Reduces chassis rigidity: medium mount softened slap-down, slightly less peg vibration, more lean-angle traction; soft mount for fast desert-type tracks.
products.supporting_parts: Keefer raised sag 103 to 105 mm to compensate for added front bite.

rider_feedback.author: Kris Keefer
rider_feedback.summary: Medium mounts: less harsh slap-down, more lean traction. Also notes cutting centre from stock top mount and shimming engine mounts as cheaper flex tweaks.

products.caveats: No part numbers, price or manufacturer page.

products.product: Axle blocks (floating)
products.what_it_changes: Floating block moves a few mm under load: slightly more rear traction out of corners and plushness on square edges (subtle).

rider_feedback.author: Kris Keefer
rider_feedback.summary: Subtle gain in rear traction and square-edge comfort.

products.caveats: No part number; 22 mm axle-specific fitment not confirmed.
